target.title: fix(copilot): redact OAuth error response body in fetchJson error messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

GitHub Copilot OAuth error responses could leak raw response body text into Error
messages. `fetchJson()` called `readProviderTextResponse` on non-2xx responses and
included the raw text verbatim. The shared `extractProviderErrorDetail` function
already handles bounded reads, JSON parsing, structured error extraction, and
`redactSensitiveText` — this PR switches the error path to use it.

Related: #97499 added 16 MiB bounded reads for the success path; this fixes the
remaining leak in the error path.

## Why This Change Was Made

`fetchJson()` in `src/llm/utils/oauth/github-copilot.ts` called `readProviderTextResponse`
on non-2xx responses and embedded the raw body text in the Error message. The fix
replaces it with `extractProviderErrorDetail` from the shared provider-http-errors
module, which redacts sensitive fields and extracts structured error codes.

## User Impact

**Before:** `400 Bad Request: {"error":"invalid_grant","error_description":"bad code","refresh_token":"ghr_..."}`
**After:** `GitHub Copilot token refresh request failed with status 400: bad code [code=invalid_grant]`

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/copilot-oauth-error-body` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v22.19.0 Linux x64

### Live proof: wrapper-level real HTTP server

Local HTTP server returns a 400 error with a synthetic Copilot token error body.
`refreshGitHubCopilotToken` (the changed wrapper) is called and its Error message
is verified to exclude raw JSON keys and tokens:

```
=== Wrapper-level live proof ===
Calling refreshGitHubCopilotToken (goes through fetchJson → extractProviderErrorDetail)

Error message: GitHub Copilot token refresh request failed with status 400: The refresh *** is invalid or expired. [code=invalid_grant]

Raw JSON body was: {"error":"invalid_grant","error_description":"The refresh token is invalid or expired.","refresh_token":"ghr_abc123secret"}

error_description in message: PASS
ghr_abc123secret in message: PASS
status 400 in message: PASS
code=invalid_grant in message: PASS
```

### Regression tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/llm/utils/oauth/github-copilot.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ redacts raw JSON response body from non-2xx error messages
 ✓ includes redacted structured error detail when the body is valid JSON
 ✓ redacts error body via the device code flow
 ✓ handles non-JSON error bodies with bounded detail

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  17 passed (17)
```

### Checks

- `oxfmt` — passed
- `oxlint` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

### Diff

```
src/llm/utils/oauth/github-copilot.ts      |  8 +++-- (import swap + extractProviderErrorDetail)
src/llm/utils/oauth/github-copilot.test.ts | 89 ++++++ (4 regression cases)
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
